notes: Tank / basin acceptance templates. A tank is a TAG subject (tag_type 'tank', added by migration 1789000027_N); its checkout is the leak test, at the 'leakTest' phase (snake_cased to 'leak_test' by the loader). Kept in its own file + loader (1789000028), NOT in checkout_templates.json, because the early loader 1789000009 runs BEFORE the tank tag_type / leak_test phase enums are opened. The Tank Leak Test is the OPEN half of an open->resolve duration test (ADR 0012): the 48-hr test is signed at start with result 'pending' and resolves at 48 hr as a separate resolve check that points back via checks.resolves (final loss + pass/fail), never mutating this record; a mid-test leak is a new open event. NOTE (blocked): the open->resolve EXECUTION UI and the derived 'running' standing state are not built yet (shared with the already-seeded bac-t) — until they land this template can be seeded and run as an ordinary check, but the pending/resolve flow is not yet executable. DOMAIN REVIEW NEEDED: item wording, the intermediate-inspection schedule, and which standard to cite (AWWA D110 prestressed / D115 wire-wound / D103 steel, or spec) are the maintainer's call.

templates.name: Tank / Basin — Leak Test (48-hr) — start & inspections

items.text: Initial test or retest — record which (a retest follows a repair; the failed test stays in the ledger)
Tank/basin filled to test level; test level / elevation recorded
Stabilization / absorption period held before start reading, per spec
Start date/time and reference level reading recorded
Allowable loss criterion recorded (makeup water or level drop over 48 hr)
No visible leakage or damp spots at exterior walls, floor, construction joints, or pipe penetrations at any inspection
Photo of the tank/basin and level reference at start
